summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Voiladi iteration 5 with new editorial/magazine-style UI redesign. All routes load without console errors. Backend APIs (32/32 tests) and frontend UI flows fully functional. Discover spread (single profile, scrollable), action bar with Voila quota, likes page with match modal, chat room with icebreakers, profile pages, and visual design all verified.
passed_tests: Backend: All 32 API tests passed (100% success rate)
Backend: GET /api/me/stats returns voilas_left, voila_weekly_limit:5, matches, likes_received, likes_sent, voilas_used_week
Welcome page: illustration loads, headline visible after masked reveal, Get started button navigates to /auth
Auth: country select to +1 United States, phone input 9990000004, Send code, dev code card appears, Use this code logs in and lands on /discover
Discover spread: discover-card-active present, hero shows name and mono meta line, photo cycling works (01 / 0N), spread body scrollable
Discover: About section, Into chips, numbered photos with hearts, prompt blocks, footer Report/Block buttons present
Discover: Open profile button opens profile-sheet with carousel, prompts, Report/Block, sheet-like-button and sheet-pass-button work
Action bar: discover-pass-button, discover-like-button, discover-voila-button present and functional
Action bar: discover-voila-left shows '5 left' and is visible
Keyboard shortcuts: ArrowRight advances to next profile (like action)
Filters: filters-open-button opens filters-drawer with segmented control and sliders, filters-apply-button present
Likes: grid with 6 tiles numbered 01.., name + '% match', context line visible
Likes: likes-like-back-button creates match, match-modal appears with title 'It's a Voila.', two square photos visible
Match modal: match-say-hi-button navigates to chat room
Chat room: bubbles (mine = black fill, theirs = white with hairline), send message via chat-message-input + chat-send-button works
Chat: icebreakers drawer (chat-icebreakers-open-button -> icebreakers-drawer -> icebreaker-chip fills input) works
Chat: menu (chat-menu-button) opens with report dialog, submit shows toast 'Report received. Thank you.'
Profile: cover with name overlay (profile-name), stats strip (profile-stat-matches, profile-stat-likes, profile-stat-voilas) display correctly
Profile: profile-edit-button, profile-preferences-button, profile-logout-button, profile-preview-button all functional
Profile: logout-dialog appears and returns to /welcome on confirm
Visual sanity: Playfair Display font on headings (h1), no pink/neon colors detected, editorial design with near-square corners and hairlines maintained
Visual sanity: toasts are white with hairline border (not red/green fills)
notes: Previous iteration (iteration_4) used iOS-style card stack; this iteration successfully replaced it with single scrollable spread as designed
Seeded test account +19990000004 used for testing
6 likes seeded for testing likes page and match flow
Button font is Roboto Mono (correct for action bar buttons with vo-mono class, not an issue)
